diagnostics.message: `module.eks_managed_node_group:resource.aws_eks_node_group.this` should wait for `module.eks_managed_node_group:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this` so EKS has the node-role permissions before creating or deleting the managed node group. The provider documentation specifically recommends this ordering; the launch-template dependency only covers cases where that template is actually created.

`module.eks_managed_node_group:resource.aws_eks_node_group.this` should depend on `module.eks_managed_node_group:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this` to ensure the node-role permissions are attached before EKS creates or deletes the managed node group. The AWS provider documentation recommends this ordering, and the launch-template dependency does not guarantee it when the module uses no created launch template.
